findings.evidence: The statements use only `E G` with `[InnerProductSpace ℝ E]`, `OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl`, `Orientation.localOrientation` and `complZeroPairIso`. The proofs only call `Orientation/Chart.lean` API: grep finds `singularHomologyComplSingletonIsoOfOrientation_refl_hom` at Chart.lean:168 and `reducedSingularHomologySphereIsoOfOrientation_hom_naturality` at Chart.lean:68. Grepping for `localOrientation_eq_localOrientationOfOrientedChart_refl` finds no public version on main (only the comment at LocalOrientation.lean:50).
findings.fix: Move all three into `AlgebraicTopology/Singular/LocalHomology/Orientation/Linear.lean` (or `Orientation/Chart.lean`, next to `singularHomologyComplSingletonIsoOfOrientation_refl_hom`) and make them public. Use the names planned in #37381 (`LinearIsometryEquiv.localHomologyMap_localOrientationOfOrientedChart_refl`, `Orientation.localOrientation_eq_localOrientationOfOrientedChart_refl`) so that whichever PR lands second simply drops its copy.
findings.issue: Three lemmas are private here but only involve real inner product spaces: `snd_complZeroPairIso_comp_complSingletonHomotopyEquivSphere` (l.62), `map_localOrientationOfOrientedChart_refl_linearIsometryEquiv` (l.84) and `localOrientation_eq_refl_localOrientationOfOrientedChart` (l.115). Nothing in them is specific to Riemann surfaces. PR #37381 is not on main, so exporting them adds no second API to main; keeping them private hides them from everyone else on main until that PR lands.

summary: The private identity-chart lemmas in `LocalOrientation.lean` are general results about local orientations of real inner product spaces that don't depend on complex charts, so keeping them private here hides reusable infrastructure. The other contested finding (`hasFDerivAt_sub_mul_of_continuousAt`) is resolved: the PR now uses main's `HasFDerivAt.smul_of_eq_zero`, and the rest of the new public surface is appropriately scoped.
